Class InteractionContext

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.client.interaction.InteractionContext
public final class InteractionContext extends Object
One right-click, in the terms the rules ask about: who clicked, what they hit, which modifiers were held, and the placement mode in force. A context built from an empty-hand or held-item click has no clicked block, so block-specific queries return false.

The context also carries the rules' one output, cancelEvent(), which the event handler reads back after the walk to decide whether the click is taken from vanilla.
